cards.name: Otakemaru the Accuser

effects.lua_implementation: AddSynchroProcedure requires a TYPE_TUNER+TYPE_SPIRIT tuner and one or more non-Tuners.

official_references.matched_structure: T.G. Hyper Librarian supplies standard one-Tuner/one-plus-non-Tuner Synchro procedure structure.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: other Spirit monsters cannot return to hand or Extra Deck by card effect during this turn’s End Phase.
effects.lua_implementation: The Special Summon trigger installs End-Phase-only CANNOT_TO_HAND/CANNOT_TO_DECK effects for other face-up Spirit monsters; those destination effects also apply to costs and non-effect movement.

official_references.matched_structure: Yata-Garasu provides the official End Phase Spirit return being suppressed.

effects.issue: Confirmed as an engine granularity gap: the standard destination prohibitions cannot be limited to REASON_EFFECT. EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN covers built-in Spirit returns but would under-implement arbitrary card effects named by this text.

effects.printed_clause: Opponent cannot target Spirit monsters you control with effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A field CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET applies aux.tgoval to face-up Spirits.

official_references.matched_structure: Protecting Spirit Loagaeth supplies official effect-target protection structure.

effects.printed_clause: If a Spirit is Normal Summoned: target an opponent card; return it to hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed field EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS trigger accepts either player’s Normal Summoned Spirit, targets one opponent on-field card, and returns it if related.

official_references.matched_structure: Compulsory Evacuation Device supplies official target-and-return operation.

effects.printed_clause: End Phase if this was Special Summoned this turn: return it to Extra Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A forced PHASE_END trigger checks STATUS_SPSUMMON_TURN and sends the related Synchro to LOCATION_EXTRA.

official_references.matched_structure: Shinobaroness Shade Peacock/Spirit Extra Deck monsters use phase-timed return procedures.

effects.printed_clause: If it returned, Special Summon two Spirits from GY, one Tuner and one non-Tuner, total Levels 9, ignoring conditions.
effects.lua_implementation: After successful Extra return, subgroup selection requires exactly two, total level 9, both tuner-role classes, two zones and no Blue-Eyes Spirit lock; SpecialSummon uses nocheck/nolimit true.

official_references.matched_structure: Soul Charge supplies multi-monster GY Special Summon structure; official ignore-condition summons use nocheck=true.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved reason-filtering limitation in destination prohibitions.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
